name: Debbie Hanna
bio:
I’ve been a licensed REALTOR® since 2007. I’m originally from Arkansas and moved to Baton Rouge to attend LSU, where I earned my degree in music education. Before real estate, I spent 12 years in sales and marketing with Warner-Elektra-Atlantic Corp. in Los Angeles.

I was named Realtor of the Year by the Greater Baton Rouge Association of REALTORS® in 2019 and Most Cooperative Realtor in 2015, graduated from the Louisiana REALTORS® leadership program in 2015, and currently serve on the GBRAR Board of Directors.

Whether I’m representing buyers or sellers, my goal is a smooth, well-managed experience that takes as much stress out of the process as possible.

reviews.quote: Debbie Hanna was great! She was always accommodating & worked around my schedule. Felt I was working with a friend not an agent!
